about.lead: I'm a web developer who enjoys building web applications and learning new things.
about.body:
I'm currently working as a Web Developer Intern at CV Access Media, gaining experience through real-world projects.

I started learning through personal projects and competitions, including LKS Web Technology and an IoT project at school. I'm always looking for new things to learn and ways to improve my skills. Currently, I'm also interested in learning more about cloud technologies.
about.currentlyIntoText: Cloud tech — Linux, Docker, AWS, CI/CD, SQL Server
